premises: Severe deformation of Ni30Co30Cr10Fe10Al18W2 EHEA creates a mixed fcc/B2 microstructure with non-uniform recrystallization.
A low-temperature anneal can selectively recrystallize the fcc phase while leaving the B2 phase unrecrystallized.
Selective recrystallization yields fully recrystallized, equiaxed fcc grains embedded in a skeletal B2 network.
This microstructure enables ~35% uniform elongation and ~2 GPa true stress.
